name: scan-project
description: Run an assurance scan against the current project, then propose fixes for any gaps. The most common starting workflow.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Numeric ID of the visible registered Assurance Scan project.

parameters.name: checkout_path
parameters.description: Absolute path to the local checkout used only to inspect or edit source.

prompt:
Use the `assurance-scan` MCP server to scan this project. Do NOT try to start any server or install Python packages — the service is already running.

**project_id is {{project_id}}** — use it for MCP project selection. **checkout_path is {{checkout_path}}** — use it only to inspect or edit source. If either is missing, ask the user; `bootstrap` has no implicit project fallback.

Steps:
1. Call `bootstrap` with `project_id={{project_id}}` to confirm a catalogue exists in the DB. If `catalogue_exists: false`, run the `author-fr-catalogue` workflow first.
2. Call `start_scan` with `project_id={{project_id}}`. Do NOT pass `fr_catalog_path` — the server reads the catalogue from the DB.
3. Poll `get_scan_status` with the returned `run_id` until `status == "completed"` (expect ~90 seconds; first run ~3-5 minutes for scanner DB downloads).
4. Call `get_findings` and `get_gap_analysis` for the same `run_id`.
5. Read the relevant source files under {{checkout_path}} (using your own Read/Grep tools) and propose a table of fixes grouped by theme.

Note: FR gaps drive the compliance matrix. If a scanner found HIGH findings but no FR failed, the project is missing a scanner-coverage FR (an FR with a scanner-clean-by-severity test that gates on that scanner's HIGHs). Flag this as a catalogue gap — re-run `author-fr-catalogue` to add the missing scanner FR.

Do NOT apply fixes yet — wait for my approval. After approval, apply the fixes under {{checkout_path}}, then call `start_scan` again with `project_id={{project_id}}` to verify the gaps closed.

The catalogue and mapping live in the DB — never read or write ./fr-catalog.json or ./fr-compliance-mapping.json.
